name: Input
summary: Single-line text field with a label, hint and error message. Label, hint and error are part of the component, so they are always linked correctly.
use: Short free input: name, email address, amount, search term.
avoid: A choice from a fixed list: use Select or Radio.
anatomy: Field: optional leading icon, value or placeholder.
Hint: extra explanation below the field.
Error message: replaces the hint when State=Error.
figmaProps: Placeholder, Filled, Hover, Focus, Error, Error focus, Disabled
Only hide the label visually, never in code.
Icon leading / Leading icon / Help icon
Fixed text before the value, for example "€".
Fixed text after the value, for example "per month".
reactProps: Hidden visually, still there for screen readers.
Sets aria-invalid and links the message.
Fixed text before or after the value. Read out through aria-describedby.
behaviour: Focus: border in the brand color plus a focus ring.
Error: red border and error message. Stays until the input is correct.
Disabled: you cannot edit it, lower contrast colors.
a11y: The label is linked with for/id. Hint and error with aria-describedby.
A placeholder is not a label and disappears when you type.
content: Error message: say what is wrong and how to fix it. "Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com."
Only use a placeholder as an example of the format.
do: Validate when the user leaves the field or submits, not on every key press.
Mark optional fields if most fields are required (or the other way round).
dont: A placeholder as the only label.
Error messages without a solution ("Invalid input").
